In Sept 2022, when NO other doctor dared 🔥, I organized & led a press conference/rally on the California Capitol steps against AB 2098—the bill branding COVID “misinformation” as unprofessional conduct, threatening license revocation for defying “scientific consensus.” 🩺🚫

Newsom called it a “witch hunt” for doctors... then signed it himself 😡. He knew: silence physicians, control patients. I stood up because the doctor-patient relationship was under siege. Spies in exam rooms? Forced propaganda on shots & mandates? UNACCEPTABLE. 🚨

Speakers included Dr. Len Saputo (50+ yrs licensed), Atty Leigh Dundas, Steve Kirsch & more. We warned: this destroys informed consent, violates 1st Amendment & Hippocratic Oath, sets precedent for ANY treatment (pain meds, chemo next?) ⚖️💉

Newsom signed anyway. 10 days later: first demand letter. Agents in black suits, guns holstered, tailed me to 5 locations. Manila envelope under my door—demanding patient charts without consent. 🕵️‍♂️

I refused. On June 5, 2023, live on The Adam King Show, I mailed my license & DEA number back to the Board 📬. Patients were prepped; I chose truth over compliance. 💪

I feel that targeting and retaliation cost me my CA medical license & Board Certifications in Anesthesiology & Critical Care (notified Dec 2024). No regrets. Zero. 🙅‍♀️

We spotlighted the tyranny—CA repealed AB 2098 in 2023 amid lawsuits & backlash. A stand for medical freedom, free speech, & patients’ right to full info. 🇺🇸🗣️

WAIT UNTIL THE END ⬇️ If they can silence your doctor, they can silence YOU. 

I fought for us all. ✊
#MedicalFreedom #AB2098 #NeverComply @DrMargaretShow
